# Play — Tartan

- SudokuPad: [Tartan on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Tartan on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The skyscraper clues are native f-puzzles constraints. The entropic and modular lines are drawn as cosmetic coloured lines
(orange and teal), so the apps won't enforce them; the rules text covers them. I have not opened the links in a browser.
If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the reference picture.

Entropic lines (orange): rows 2, 5 and 8, all nine cells each. Modular lines (teal): columns 2, 5 and 8, all nine cells each.

Skyscrapers: above column 1: 6; above column 9: 3; left of row 1: 8; left of row 8: 5; below column 1: 4; below column 4: 4.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
